items.title: Zelensky says Russia deliberately struck Kyiv and Boryspil airports overnight, calling the attacks a response to discussions about US representatives potentially flying into Ukraine. He said Ukraine recorded the move and will adjust its operation concerning Russian airspace next week, while stressing Kyiv poses no threat to diplomacy. The same overnight attack killed four people and wounded five in Kamianske, while homes and shopping centers were damaged in several regions. #Ukraine

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff says Ukrainian forces struck several Russian military targets on September 4. A radar was hit in Kartushyn, an electronic warfare system near Pogar and a MESH network repeater in Zlynka, all in Russia's Bryansk region. Ukrainian forces also struck a repair base used by a Russian unit in Sokolohirsk, occupied Luhansk region. The extent of the damage is still being assessed. #Ukraine

items.title: Ukraine's NABU and SAPO say they exposed a criminal organization led by an official in the Prosecutor General's Office. The group allegedly took systematic bribes to protect fraudulent call centers and laundered more than UAH 42 million through property, valuables, third parties and bank accounts. Five members were identified. #Ukraine

items.title: ❗️The Kremlin does not expect a breakthrough from Witkoff and Kushner's visit, Bloomberg reports. Sources say previous US envoy trips produced no result and Moscow expects no new acceptable proposals. They say Putin is ready to end the war only on his terms, with Russian demands hardening as Moscow sees a military advantage. #Ukraine

items.title: R to @NOELreports: Kushner and Witkoff will visit Moscow and Kyiv in coming days
items.summary:
Kushner and Witkoff will visit Moscow and Kyiv in coming days
NOELREPORTS 🇪🇺 🇺🇦 (@NOELreports)
Zelensky says Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will visit Moscow in the coming days and Kyiv on Sunday. Ukraine will refrain from airstrikes during their visit to Moscow so the US representatives can arrive safely, and Zelensky said Russia should mirror the pause during their time in Kyiv. He said Ukraine is preparing for substantive talks aimed at finding real options to move the war toward an end. #Ukraine
